newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Cricket-Pakistan win toss, choose to bat vs NZ.
newsitem.headline: Cricket-Pakistan win toss, choose to bat vs NZ.

text.p: Pakistan won the toss and elected to bat in the first one-day international against New Zealand in Gujranwala on Wednesday.
The 50 over-a-side match was reduced to 46 overs because the start was delayed by half an hour due to sun glare.
Pakistan - Saeed Anwar, Zahoor Elahi, Ijaz Ahmad, Inzamamul Haq, Salim Malik, Shahid Afridi, Wasim Akram (captain), Moin Khan, Mushtaq Ahmad, Waqar Younis, Saqlain Mushtaq.
New Zealand - Bryan Young, Craig Spearman, Adam Parore, Stephen Fleming, Nathan Astle, Chris Cairns, Chris Harris, Lee Germon (captain), Dipak Patel, Simon Doull, Robert Kennedy.
